result.answer:
I can't connect it myself, so I sent a request to the Inhouse team (tr_17). It asks for read access to TikTok Shop orders, plus products and inventory if possible. It also asks them to tell you if they need anything from you, such as authorizing the account.

Until it's connected, I can't see TikTok orders. The only open request before this was Klaviyo (tr_12), which is still in progress.
